title: Runtime Control for AI Agents: Closing the Evaluation--Execution Gap in Operational Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.27480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly participate in operational workflows where approvals, binds, and payments create commitments. An approval valid when issued may no longer authorize execution after relevant facts, evidence, policy, or authority change. We call this the evaluation--execution gap. We specify a state-bound runtime assurance layer that separates probabilistic measurement from deterministic adjudication, binds an execution allowance to the decision-relevant basis of an approval, invalidates that allowance after relevant logged changes, and rechecks admissibility at dispatch. This distinguishes the continued validity of a prior approval from a current-state policy check. We describe eight failure modes, an assurance model, a reference architecture, and prospective interventions with retrospective remediation. translated_title: 面向AI智能体的运行时控制：弥合运营工作流中的评估—执行鸿沟
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体日益参与到各类运营工作流中，在这些工作流里，审批、绑定和支付等操作会产生实际承诺。一份在颁发时有效的审批，在相关事实、证据、政策或权限发生变化后，可能不再能够授权执行。我们将这一现象称为“评估—执行鸿沟”。本文规范了一个状态绑定的运行时保障层，它将概率性测量与确定性裁决相分离，将执行许可绑定到审批的决策相关依据上，在相关变更被记录后使该许可失效，并在调度执行时重新检查可容许性，从而区分了先前审批的持续有效性与基于当前状态的策略检查。我们描述了八种故障模式、一个保障模型、一个参考架构，以及前瞻性干预措施与回顾性补救方案。在一个包含42个案例的脚本化重放实验中，状态绑定配置识别出了15个事后已失效的审批，而基线方法未能发现这些失效情况。
tldr: 提出一种状态绑定的运行时保障层，通过将执行许可绑定到审批的决策依据、在相关变更后使其失效并在调度时重新检查，从而弥合AI智能体在运营工作流中的评估—执行鸿沟。
en_tdlr: Proposes a state-bound runtime assurance layer that closes the evaluation-execution gap for AI agents by binding execution allowances to the decision-relevant basis of approvals, invalidating them upon relevant logged changes, and rechecking admissibility at dispatch.
